tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Washington's DeepSeek ban may deter US firms from adopting Chinese models. Reported by The Star: the US bans DeepSeek for national security while China calls it discriminatory, affecting adoption.
Gemini is making your Google smart home slower, prompting users to switch. Reported by How-To Geek: Google's Gemini rollout has degraded Google Home functionality.
ChatGPT has ranked which states are stupidest, smelliest, and hottest. Reported by Yahoo News Singapore: ChatGPT ranks states on intelligence, smell, and beauty, reinforcing geographic stereotypes.
Microsoft Teams adds GitHub Copilot with a new combined app. Reported by TechJuice: Microsoft merges GitHub apps into Teams, adding artificial intelligence context and a deadline for deprecation.
OpenAI launches a new tool that makes decisions up to 10 times faster. Reported by ProPakistani: OpenAI's Decisions API cuts decision time to 100–180 milliseconds, offering faster, cheaper artificial intelligence for developers.
Free every hour.
